component.name: Field Command
component.summary: Real-time strategy: mine crystal, build an army, destroy the enemy base

description.p: Field Command is a classic real-time strategy game. Engineers mine crystal and construct a base, Barracks and Factories train Rangers and Siege Tanks, and a computer opponent expands, defends and sends escalating attack waves.

ul.li: Three difficulty levels and an on-screen objectives guide for new players
Online and LAN multiplayer for up to 4 players, free-for-all or teams, with computer players
Fog of war, forests, expansions and a clickable minimap
Shift-queued orders, control groups, rally points and attack-move
All artwork and sound effects are generated procedurally
